messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High RPM spike detected for model hydra-7b in us-west-2. 99th p99 token latency rising and request queue growing. Possible bulk ingestion.

alex (oncall): Acked. Paging in. Pulling graphs and top API keys now. Anyone see deployment churn?

sasha (platform): No deploys in last hour. Snapshot: hydra-7b RPM ~18k, TPM ~65k, queue depth 210 (baseline <25), pod GPU util 98%. Top api keys: acct-alpha (41%), acct-batchlabs (27%), residual dev keys (32%).

puneet (sre): If autoscaler is pegged, emergency knobs: per-model RPM/TM reduction, per-key throttles, or opt to shed non-critical tiers (free/dev). Which to apply first depends on customer impact.

lina (support): We're already getting CS tickets from acct-alpha complaining about 503s and long tail responses. They say it's their nightly bulk job; asking for immediate support.

alex (oncall): Plan: 1) apply quick per-model throttle in us-west-2 to bring RPM ~3000, TPM ~12000 2) add short-term per-key caps for acct-alpha and acct-batchlabs 3) toggle off experimental streaming for hydra-7b for non-pro accounts 4) communicate to support and customers. I'm handing mitigation to sasha; I'll coordinate comms.

sasha (platform): I'll run the changes. Executing staged rollout (5% -> 50% -> 100%) to avoid a control-plane thundering herd. Commands: 
```
redctl quota set --model hydra-7b --region us-west-2 --rpm 3000 --tpm 12000 --staged true
redctl quota key-adjust --key acct-alpha --rpm 600 --burst 800
redctl quota key-adjust --key acct-batchlabs --rpm 700 --burst 700
redctl feature-toggle set --model hydra-7b --feature streaming --state off --scope non-pro
```

sasha (platform): Changes submitted to control plane, audit id qchg-9f2d. Rolling first 5% patch now.

deploy-bot: Quota update job queued (qchg-9f2d). Progress: 5% applied.

puneet (sre): Observability: queue depth -> 130 after 5%. p99 dropped from 3.6s -> 2.4s. Good sign but keep watching error patterns (429/503 mix).

lina (support): Notifying affected customers: "We detected heavy traffic and applied temporary limits to stabilize service. We're reaching out with mitigation details." Posting to support channel.

sasha (platform): 50% rollout: queue depth -> 48, p99 -> 1.6s, GPU util ~82%. Top keys show reduced counts. Proceeding to 100%.

incident-bot: Action logged: quota-change by sasha at 1814150120. audit qchg-9f2d.

sasha (platform): 100% complete. Aggregate RPM for hydra-7b ~3.1k. Observed 429s for acct-alpha ~12%, acct-batchlabs ~9%. misc-dev keys saw little change.

puneet (sre): Good outcome. Two quick items: ensure rate-limit headers set so clients back off, and create a temporary backoff policy (Retry-After) via edge.

sasha (platform): Adding headers now and creating Retry-After of 10s for hard 429 responses.

lina (support): acct-alpha replied: their bulk job misconfigured -- they ramped to 100k req/min. They've paused and will re-run with chunking. acct-batchlabs will throttle on their side.

alex (oncall): Customer impact assessment: primary impact medium-high for those two customers (failed bulk jobs, 429s). Platform risk mitigated. No broad data loss. Escalation level: stayed internal. Target next steps: keep throttles for 30m, then canary bump if customers confirm backoff.

puneet (sre): Creating ops ticket INC-2026-HYDRA-Q for follow-up (alerts, SLO guardrails, per-key burst detection). sasha, drop audit ids and link.

sasha (platform): INC-2026-HYDRA-Q created and linked to qchg-9f2d. I'll keep mitigations in place. Proposed canary plan: after 30m stable, raise RPM -> 7000 (canary 10% for 15m) then to 100% if metrics good.

deploy-bot: Scheduled oncall handover: alex -> puneet at 1814151800.

alex (oncall): I'll stay through the canary step and hand off if stable. Lina, please add customer case notes and remediation guidance to both accounts.

lina (support): Done. Provided guidance: chunking requests, exponential backoff, and suggested per-minute caps.

sasha (platform): 30m stable window complete. Metrics steady: queue <25, p99 ~0.9s, GPU util 68%. Proceeding with canary increase: 
```
redctl quota set --model hydra-7b --region us-west-2 --rpm 7000 --tpm 28000 --canary 10
```

sasha (platform): Canary 10% healthy after 15m. Rolling to 100%. audit qchg-9f2e logged.

puneet (sre): Closing active mitigation. Follow-ups for INC-2026-HYDRA-Q: 1) implement per-key surge detector (>5x baseline) 2) consider soft throttles (token bucket with graceful headers) 3) document recommended burst caps for hydra-7b in devex.

alex (oncall): Thanks team. I'll write a brief blameless postmortem and include timeline & remediation actions. Handing oncall to puneet now.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active mitigation. All actions recorded under INC-2026-HYDRA-Q and audits qchg-9f2d/qchg-9f2e."
